q1_issues.issue: "next to the table" answers *where*, so the instruction set routes it to the event oblique (Location sk_stand_1 sk_table_1); RightNextTo is a coined relation head and additionally folds the intensifier "right" into the relation name.

q2_gaps: degree/proximity intensifier on a spatial PP ("right next to") — Degree covers adjectives and quantities, Manner covers event adverbs, and neither reaches a modifier sitting on a locative PP
notes: Tense/aspect (Past + Ongoing from the past progressive) and the postural-stative Experiencer subject are both exactly per the instruction set, as is the definite "the table" as a typed witness. Routing the PP to Location does lose the adjacency relation, but that coarsening is what the instruction set prescribes for a where-PP.
